prayerExcerpt.en-US: The Saints were tempted even more than ourselves; but they stood where we fall, because they trusted to Mary, and not to themselves.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Os Santos foram tentados ainda mais do que nós; mas mantiveram-se firmes onde nós caímos, porque confiaram em Maria, e não em si mesmos.

meta.face: An Englishman of about sixty-five, spare from fasting, with a fair, pale complexion and a LEAN, ANGULAR face WIDEST at HIGH, SHARP cheekbones — a TALL, straight forehead, a nose with a pronounced DOWNWARD HOOK at its tip, PALE-GREY, deep-set, kindly eyes under thin, level grey brows, deep vertical lines beside a THIN-LIPPED, gently smiling mouth, a small, POINTED chin; CLEAN-SHAVEN; thin grey hair cut short below the mitre; the gaze mild and thoughtful. Not the long-headed, jutting-chinned, short-bearded anselm, the long, fine-nosed thomas_becket, the triangular, hollow simon_stock, the square-bearded augustine_canterbury, the bulge-browed elphege or the broad, snub-nosed richard_chichester.
meta.basis: No portrait from life survives; the lead image on English Wikipedia is a Nuremberg Chronicle woodcut. The lean, ascetic scholar follows the book and Wikipedia (lecturer at Paris and Oxford, an ascetic); Pontigny is where the book says he lies.
